definitions: (of a loud noise) repeated several times as an echo.
(of a place) seemed to vibrate or resound with a loud noise.
(of an event, idea, or statement) had far-reaching effects or repercussions.
examples: The sound of the explosion reverberated through the valley.
The hall reverberated with the cheers of the crowd.
His words reverberated in her mind long after he had left.
